'''2022 MPC Chris Terwilliger LS WHAP''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Terwilliger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open We Have A Plan Terwilliger LS 2022.txt |Download]]
